display_policy.scope: Upstream contribution tables only; owned projects are separately displayed.

search_verification.method: Fresh incremental recheck from the overlapping UTC closure window since 2026-11-22, compared with the pinned preceding complete inventory. No new merged identities were found, so no new direct-PR receipts were required. Four historical creation-date partition totals cross-check the merged-only search, not a fresh complete historical identity enumeration.
search_verification.note: The freshly executed overlap searches returned the same 99 merged identities, all already present in the pinned inventory. The cumulative total therefore remains 1,553. The count difference of three between merged-only partition totals and accessible inventory is consistent with previously reconciled omissions; historical identities are retained rather than claimed freshly re-enumerated.
